name: canvas-mcp
description: Canvas LMS MCP server with FERPA-aware anonymization, account-admin tools, grading suite, and a TypeScript code-execution escape hatch.
long_description: Drop-in MCP server for Canvas LMS. Lists/creates Canvas content (courses, modules, pages, quizzes, assignments, rubrics), reads + grades submissions (single and bulk with dry-run + bounded concurrency), and exposes execute_typescript for token-efficient bulk operations against a curated code_api/. Every student-data path defaults to pseudonymized output (Student 1, Student 2, …) with a per-course persistent map on disk so longitudinal artifacts stay coherent. De-anonymization is gated by the operator — Claude cannot turn it off without an explicit env opt-in. Ships an optional Franklin School preset (9 TD Competencies) that other schools can swap by pointing SCHOOL_CONFIG at their own JSON file.

canvas_api_url.title: Canvas URL
canvas_api_url.description: Your school's Canvas address, e.g. https://yourschool.instructure.com

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_api_token.description: From Canvas: click your Account avatar → Settings → '+ New Access Token'. Paste the token here. It's stored locally and only sent to your Canvas host — never to Anthropic or anywhere else.

allow_deanonymize.title: Allow real student names in tool output? (leave false unless you need it)
allow_deanonymize.description: By default this MCP returns pseudonyms (Student 1, Student 2, …) for every student — teachers/TAs/admins always come through verbatim. This is the FERPA-safe default. Type 'true' here ONLY for a workflow that genuinely needs real names (e.g., looking up a Canvas user id from a student's actual name). Restart Claude Desktop after changing. Flip it back to blank when you're done.

school_config.title: School config (optional)
school_config.description: Optional JSON file describing your school's competency framework. Franklin teachers: point at ${__dirname}/configs/franklin.json to load Franklin's 9 TD Competencies. Other schools: copy ${__dirname}/configs/example.json and edit. Leave blank to skip — every other tool works without it.
